name: woocommerce-payments/accept-dispute
label: Accept a dispute
description: Accept (concede) a dispute. The disputed funds are forfeited to the cardholder permanently. This cannot be undone.

dispute_id.description: Stripe dispute ID (typically `du_…` or legacy `dp_…`). Stripe ID prefixes are not contractually stable, so this field is not pattern-validated.

name: woocommerce-payments/get-account
label: Get WooPayments account state
description: Return the merchant's WooPayments account state: onboarding status, country, store and customer currencies, KYC requirements, deadlines, and test/live mode flags.

name: woocommerce-payments/get-active-loan-summary
label: Get active Capital loan summary
description: Return the merchant's active Stripe Capital loan summary. Answers 'how much do I still owe on my Capital loan and what is the daily repayment rate?'. Returns an empty shape if no loan is active.

name: woocommerce-payments/get-authorizations
label: List authorizations
description: List uncaptured card authorizations. Answers 'which authorizations expire soon / still need capture?'.

per_page.description: Maximum number of items per page.

authorizations.description: Returned authorizations for the current page.

total_pages.description: Total number of result pages available for the current query.

per_page.description: Maximum number of items requested per page.

name: woocommerce-payments/get-authorizations-summary
label: Get authorizations summary
description: Return aggregate counts and total authorized amount for pending authorizations. Answers 'how much money is held in uncaptured authorizations?'.

name: woocommerce-payments/get-balance
label: Get balance summary
description: Return the balance summary (charges, refunds, disputes, fees, payouts, ending balance) for a currency over a date range.

name: woocommerce-payments/get-charge
label: Get charge by ID
description: Look up a single charge by Stripe ID (ch_… or py_…). Answers 'what happened with charge ch_X?'.

charge_id.description: Stripe charge ID (typically `ch_…` or `py_…`). Stripe ID prefixes are not contractually stable, so this field is not pattern-validated.

name: woocommerce-payments/get-deposits
label: List payouts
description: List payouts (Stripe deposits) with status, date-range, and currency filters. Answers 'show me my recent payouts'.

per_page.description: Maximum number of items per page.

deposits.description: Returned deposits for the current page.

total_pages.description: Total number of result pages available for the current query.

per_page.description: Maximum number of items requested per page.

name: woocommerce-payments/get-deposits-overview
label: Get payouts overview
description: Return a per-currency overview of upcoming and recent payouts (Stripe deposits). Answers 'when is my next payout and how much?'.

name: woocommerce-payments/get-deposits-summary
label: Get payouts summary
description: Return aggregate counts and totals of payouts by status and currency. Answers 'how many payouts have I received this month?'.

name: woocommerce-payments/get-dispute
label: Get dispute by ID
description: Look up a single dispute by ID. Answers 'what evidence is needed for dispute du_X and by when?'.

dispute_id.description: Stripe dispute ID (typically `du_…` or legacy `dp_…`). Stripe ID prefixes are not contractually stable, so this field is not pattern-validated.

name: woocommerce-payments/get-disputes
label: List disputes
description: List disputes with status and date-range filters. Answers 'which disputes need response?'.

per_page.description: Maximum number of items per page.

disputes.description: Returned disputes for the current page.

total_pages.description: Total number of result pages available for the current query.

per_page.description: Maximum number of items requested per page.

name: woocommerce-payments/get-disputes-summary
label: Get disputes summary
description: Return aggregate counts of disputes by status. Answers 'how many disputes are pending response right now?'.

name: woocommerce-payments/get-fees-summary
label: Get processing-fee summary
description: Return aggregate processing-fee totals (count, fees, net) over a date range. Answers 'how much did I pay in fees this period?'.

name: woocommerce-payments/get-fraud-outcomes
label: List flagged (fraud outcome) transactions
description: List transactions flagged by fraud protection for a given outcome status (e.g. block, review).

per_page.description: Maximum number of items per page.

status.description: Fraud outcome status to filter by (e.g. block, review).

fraud_outcomes.description: Returned fraud_outcomes for the current page.

total_pages.description: Total number of result pages available for the current query.

per_page.description: Maximum number of items requested per page.

name: woocommerce-payments/get-payment-intent
label: Get payment intent by ID
description: Look up a single payment intent by Stripe ID (pi_…). Answers 'what is the state of intent pi_X?' during incident response.

payment_intent_id.description: Stripe payment intent ID (typically `pi_…`). Stripe ID prefixes are not contractually stable, so this field is not pattern-validated.

name: woocommerce-payments/get-timeline
label: Get timeline for payment intent
description: Return the chronological event timeline for a payment intent (created → succeeded → refunded → disputed). Helps reconstruct what happened to one transaction. Takes `intention_id` (the same Stripe `pi_…` identifier accepted by `get-payment-intent` as `payment_intent_id` — both names exist because they mirror the underlying REST route parameters).

intention_id.description: Stripe payment intent ID (typically `pi_…`). Same identifier accepted by `get-payment-intent` under the field name `payment_intent_id`. Stripe ID prefixes are not contractually stable, so this field is not pattern-validated.

name: woocommerce-payments/get-transactions
label: List transactions
description: List WooPayments transactions with filters (date range, type, source device, channel, customer country, risk level, currency, search). Answers 'show me transactions where X'.

per_page.description: Maximum number of items per page.

deposit_id.description: Filter to transactions belonging to a single payout (deposit) ID. Accepted by both the list and the summary endpoints.

transactions.description: Returned transactions for the current page.

total_pages.description: Total number of result pages available for the current query.

per_page.description: Maximum number of items requested per page.

name: woocommerce-payments/get-transactions-summary
label: Get transactions summary
description: Return aggregate counts and totals for a transactions filter. Answers 'how many transactions / how much volume in this window?' without paging the list.

deposit_id.description: Filter to transactions belonging to a single payout (deposit) ID. Accepted by both the list and the summary endpoints.

name: woocommerce-payments/refund-charge
label: Refund a charge
description: Create a full or partial refund on a Stripe charge. Supply a stable idempotency_key to make retries safe — identical keys return the original refund. Amount is in minor units (e.g. cents).

charge_id.description: Stripe charge ID to refund (ch_… or py_…).

amount.description: Amount to refund in minor units (e.g. cents). Omit for a full refund.

idempotency_key.description: Required. A stable, caller-unique key so duplicate retries dedupe to the original refund instead of creating a second one. Reuse the exact same key when retrying the same logical refund.

name: woocommerce-payments/submit-dispute-evidence
label: Submit dispute evidence
description: Stage or submit evidence for a dispute. With submit=false (default) the evidence is saved as a draft you can revise; with submit=true it is sent to the card network and cannot be changed.

dispute_id.description: Stripe dispute ID (typically `du_…` or legacy `dp_…`). Stripe ID prefixes are not contractually stable, so this field is not pattern-validated.

evidence.description: Evidence fields. Text fields take free text; document fields take the ID of a file uploaded via woocommerce-payments/upload-dispute-evidence-file (not raw file contents).

product_description.description: Description of the product or service and how it was presented to the customer.

customer_purchase_ip.description: IP address the customer used for the purchase.

cancellation_rebuttal.description: Explanation of why the customer was not entitled to cancel.

access_activity_log.description: Activity log showing the customer accessed or downloaded a digital product.

uncategorized_text.description: Any additional explanation that does not fit another field.

shipping_carrier.description: Delivery service that shipped the product (e.g. USPS, FedEx, UPS, DHL).

shipping_tracking_number.description: Tracking number for a shipped physical product.

shipping_address.description: Address the product was shipped to.

customer_communication.description: Correspondence with the customer relevant to the dispute (e.g. emails). Provide the ID of a file uploaded via woocommerce-payments/upload-dispute-evidence-file, not raw file contents.

customer_signature.description: Proof the customer signed for the product or agreed to terms. Provide the ID of a file uploaded via woocommerce-payments/upload-dispute-evidence-file, not raw file contents.

receipt.description: Receipt or message sent to the customer for the charge. Provide the ID of a file uploaded via woocommerce-payments/upload-dispute-evidence-file, not raw file contents.

refund_policy.description: Your refund policy as shown to the customer. Provide the ID of a file uploaded via woocommerce-payments/upload-dispute-evidence-file, not raw file contents.

duplicate_charge_documentation.description: Documentation for the prior charge a duplicate dispute refers to. Provide the ID of a file uploaded via woocommerce-payments/upload-dispute-evidence-file, not raw file contents.

shipping_documentation.description: Proof the product was delivered (e.g. signed delivery confirmation). Provide the ID of a file uploaded via woocommerce-payments/upload-dispute-evidence-file, not raw file contents.

service_documentation.description: Proof the service was provided to the customer. Provide the ID of a file uploaded via woocommerce-payments/upload-dispute-evidence-file, not raw file contents.

cancellation_policy.description: Your cancellation policy as shown to the customer. Provide the ID of a file uploaded via woocommerce-payments/upload-dispute-evidence-file, not raw file contents.

uncategorized_file.description: Any additional supporting document. Provide the ID of a file uploaded via woocommerce-payments/upload-dispute-evidence-file, not raw file contents.

submit.description: Whether to submit to the card network (irreversible). Default false stages a draft.

metadata.description: Optional metadata to attach to the dispute. Maximum 10 keys; keys up to 40 characters; values up to 500 characters.

name: woocommerce-payments/upload-dispute-evidence-file
label: Upload dispute evidence file
description: Upload a document (PDF, PNG, or JPEG) to use as dispute evidence. Returns a file object whose id can be passed to the document fields of woocommerce-payments/submit-dispute-evidence.

file_type.description: File MIME type. One of application/pdf, image/jpeg, or image/png.

file_contents.description: Base64-encoded file contents. The decoded size must not exceed the dispute-evidence size limit.
